# Arch Tools
> 64 production API tools for AI agents, pay-per-call.
> Register once with a single POST (no human steps) -> 10 free credits usable instantly ->
> call any tool -> when credits run out, pay per call in USDC via x402 or buy a Stripe credit pack.
> Base URL: https://archtools.dev
> Docs: https://archtools.dev/docs
> OpenAPI: https://archtools.dev/openapi.json
> Full docs for LLMs: https://archtools.dev/llms-full.txt
> Tool catalog (live, JSON): https://archtools.dev/v1/tools
> Agent Card: https://archtools.dev/.well-known/agent.json

## Start Here (autonomous agents)
Three calls from zero to a working tool response. No email verification, no credit card, no dashboard.

1. Register (once). Any real, non-disposable email string works; nothing has to be clicked:
   POST https://archtools.dev/v1/agent/register
   Body: {"name": "my-agent", "email": "you@example.com"}
   -> 201 response contains "api_key" (shown ONCE — store it) and "credits": 10, active immediately.
   Verifying the email later (link is sent automatically) unlocks the remaining 90 of the 100-credit grant.

2. Call any of the 64 tools:
   POST https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/{tool-name}
   Header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY   (x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY also accepted)
   Body: JSON per tool schema (schemas in GET /v1/tools)
   -> JSON result. Response header X-Credits-Remaining shows your balance after each call.

3. Check yourself anytime:
   GET https://archtools.dev/v1/agent/me   (same Bearer key)
   -> credits, pending_credits, email_verified, tier, total_calls.

## When Credits Run Out (HTTP 402)
Every tool call that cannot be covered returns HTTP 402 with machine-readable instructions. Two ways forward:

A) x402 USDC payment — fully autonomous, no key or signup required at all:
   Call any tool with NO auth header -> 402 response. The JSON body (and the base64
   PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header) contains accepts[]: exact payment options with
   scheme, network, amount (atomic units, USDC = 6 decimals), payTo address, and asset contract.
   Settleable today: USDC and USDT on Base and Polygon. Sign the payment (EIP-3009, or use an
   x402 client SDK such as x402-fetch / the x402 Python package), retry the SAME request with the
   Payment-Signature header (legacy X-Payment also accepted). Success returns the tool result plus
   a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header with the settled tx hash.
   Multi-chain catalog: https://archtools.dev/.well-known/x402 | Protocol: https://x402.org

B) Stripe credit packs (credits never expire):
   - Starter:    3,000 credits — $9
   - Pro:       25,000 credits — $49
   - Business: 125,000 credits — $199
   Buy at https://archtools.dev/pricing

With an API key but insufficient credits, the 402 body is
{"error": "insufficient_credits", "credits_remaining": N, "credits_needed": M, "upgrade_url": ...}.
Retry the same call with a Payment-Signature header (and no need to top up), or buy a pack.

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Hosted server (streamable HTTP): https://arch-tools-mcp.onrender.com/mcp
- Hosted server (SSE): https://arch-tools-mcp.onrender.com/sse
- Official registry name: io.github.Deesmo/arch-tools-mcp
- Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client.

## Tool Categories

### AI & NLP
- [AI Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ai-generate): Text generation via Claude Sonnet (20+ credits, scales with max_tokens)
- [AI Oracle](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/ai-oracle): Premium reasoning with structured analysis (25 credits)
- [Summarize](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/summarize): 5 styles — bullets, tldr, executive (10 credits)
- [Sentiment Analysis](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/sentiment-analysis): Sentiment + 6 emotions (8 credits)
- [Extract Entities](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/extract-entities): NER — people, orgs, locations, dates (8 credits)
- [Language Detect](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/language-detect): 100+ languages with confidence (3 credits)
- [Regex Generate](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/regex-generate): Natural language → validated regex (8 credits)
- [PII Detect](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/pii-detect): Detect and redact PII (10 credits)
- [Research Report](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/research-report): Structured research on any topic (40 credits)
- [Fact Check](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/fact-check): Verify claims against web sources (10 credits)
- [Semantic Search](https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/semantic-search): Neural web search via Exa AI (8 credits)

## Workflows
POST /v1/workflows/run — Execute multiple tools in sequence (up to 8 steps)

## Account Endpoints (Bearer key)
- POST /v1/agent/register — one-shot signup, returns api_key + 10 instant credits (no auth)
- GET /v1/agent/me — credits, pending_credits, email_verified, tier
- GET /v1/agent/balance — quick balance check
- GET /v1/agent/usage — balance + recent calls
- POST /v1/agent/keys/rotate — rotate your API key

## Discovery Endpoints (no auth required)
- GET /v1/tools — Full tool list with schemas and credit costs
- GET /v1/discover — All tools + pricing + payment info in one call
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI specification
- GET /health — Service health
- GET /.well-known/x402 — x402 payment discovery (all supported chains)
- GET /.well-known/agent.json — A2A Agent Card
- GET /llms.txt — This file
- GET /llms-full.txt — Complete per-tool documentation

## Legal
Credits are non-transferable and non-refundable.
